name: shap_review
description: Evidence-driven SHAP repository review engine. Runs semantic analysis, contract oracles, fuzzing, differential analysis, and evidence-chain validation against a SHAP source checkout.
security_note: Commands in script_execution_commands execute arbitrary Python scripts via subprocess. Only invoke with trusted, controlled input paths. Do not expose to untrusted end-users without an additional restriction layer.

evidence_model.name: EvidenceChain
evidence_model.dynamic_evidence_note: The 'analyze' command runs a bounded TreeExplainer campaign against the installed SHAP runtime, not the repository under review. The runtime-bridge.json artifact records anomalies but those anomalies do not currently enrich candidate evidence chains because the generic bridge campaign does not set per-candidate fingerprints. Treat bridge output as diagnostic metadata only.
